summary: The Grand Ducal regulation of 24 July 2026 on metal and alloy food-contact materials was published in Memorial A No. 488 of 8 October 2026. Tableau 1 and Tableau 2 print specific release limits, and Article 5 prints a generic limit of 60 mg/kg. Chromium is footnoted as hexavalent chromium. Arsenic and mercury do not state a species. The hub source is the official Legilux PDF/A. The 25 printed values were checked against that PDF and match. Main had no earlier hub event for this instrument. The MANIFEST records 12 October 2026 as the in-force date from Legilux metadata. The PDF articles do not print that day.
